description: This file defines internal interfaces and a partial class 'TransportConnection' related to network connection features and their management within the Orleans framework, including feature collection handling and interface implementations for connection properties.

classes.name: TransportConnection
classes.description: A partial class implementing multiple connection-related features and managing a feature collection for network connections within Orleans.

methods.name: FastReset
methods.description: Resets internal feature references to the current object, preparing for reuse.

methods.name: ResetFeatureCollection
methods.description: Resets the feature collection, clearing extra features and incrementing revision.

methods.name: ExtraFeatureGet
methods.description: Retrieves an extra feature by type key from the list of additional features.

methods.name: ExtraFeatureSet
methods.description: Adds or updates an extra feature in the list of additional features.
